question: In 1951, the first Asian Games was held in which city?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **New Delhi** was the host city for the first Asian Games held in 1951.
 
• The Asian Games, also known as the Asiad, is a continental multi-sport event held every four years among athletes from all over Asia.
 
• The event is organized by the Asian Games Federation (AGF) and is recognized by the International Olympic Committee (IOC).
 
• The first Asian Games took place from March 4 to March 11, 1951.
 
• A total of 489 athletes from 11 National Olympic Committees participated in the event.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Asian Games were initiated to foster unity and cooperation among Asian countries post World War II.
 
• The 1951 Asian Games featured six sports: athletics, aquatics (swimming and diving), basketball, cycling, football, and weightlifting.
 
• India finished second in the medal tally, winning a total of 51 medals, including 15 golds.
 
• Japan topped the medal tally, securing 60 medals, including 24 golds.
 
• The success of the first Asian Games set the stage for future editions, with the event growing in scale and participation over the decades.
